Steric number of AlH3 is = [3 + 3] = 3

AlH3 is sp2 hybridized.

Steric number of AlH = [3 + 4 +1] = 4

AlH is sp3 hybridized.

(b) H2O + H+ H3O+

Steric no of H2O = (6+ 2) = 4

H2O s sp3 hybridized.

Steric no of H3O+ = [ 8 + 3 1] = 4

H3O+ s also sp3 hybridized.

(c) NH3 + H+ NH4+

Steric no of NH3 = [5 + 3] = 4

hybridization of NH3 is sp3

Steric number of NH4+ = [5 + 4 ] = 4

Hybridization of NH4+ is sp3
